title: Dropping reference counts
description: You can follow three objects as their root references are removed.

steps.description: Allocation starts an object's refcount at zero. You raise counts with inc_ref and trigger collection when dec_ref lowers a count to zero or below.
_collect removes the object and returns its address to free. It also decrements integer fields that may refer to other heap objects.
You allocate c, b and a at addresses 0, 1 and 2. Root references and the chain a -> b -> c give counts of one for a and two each for b and c.

steps.question: How many live objects remain after dropping a's root reference?
steps.answer: Two. a reaches zero and is freed, while b's count falls from two to one.

steps.description: The supplied output shows live counts falling from three to two, then one, then zero. You see a, b and c freed in that order as each root reference is dropped.
